policies.name: role-preserve

Designation.geometry: strong ink<200 bbox expanded8, retain original source pixels, white only outside source
Designation.weak_ink_guard: if any gray<245 bbox outside expanded8 use full PSM6

policies.limitation: Does not reproduce production KnownSingleLineRegion gates; end-to-end product qualification separate.

criterion: whole-line exact, then designation exact, then CER; prefer integer for exact ties
training_budget: 1500 samples first; if development still improves another bounded 1500 from candidate; max 3000 new samples; no blind-driven changes
reason: PSM13 ink+8 read32/32 designation on prior76 development; full-PSM6 read30/32 designation and40/44 names. This prospective policy is selected/validated only on fresh V3 development before blind.
reason_for_revision: Before any blind access, add source-pixel-preserving margin policy to protect faint accents. Requested from production safety review, not from evaluation answers.
